current_coloc_gwas.evidence: No model or selected component bundle exists, so neither inclusion nor exclusion can be attached to an immutable state.

fnih_86_liver.evidence: No model exists and the conditional source is not admitted or openly downloadable; a future seal classification requires a built-state receipt and component-level alias audit.

gse244832.evidence: No model or selected component bundle exists. Its task-specific development/training role is prospective only.

gse281160.evidence: No model exists. This exposed CROP-seq source can be used only as a retrospective direction diagnostic after prediction freezing.

gse281364.evidence: No model exists. Any future MPRA-fitted prediction must be out of fold by merged locus, sequence identity, and reverse-complement identity.

gse289173.evidence: No model, selected base, context encoder, training receipt, or selection lock exists. The sealed source therefore cannot inherit Borzoi's target-label-unexposed classification.

gse296875.evidence: No model exists. This is the intended local same-nucleus training source, so a final development fit would expose the trained state to its RNA and ATAC targets.

resource_atlas_current.evidence: No model exists and use of the current Atlas to fit the context mapper or encoder has not been frozen.

missingness_and_pairing_contract.gse244832: same_sample_different_aliquot; preserve distinct RNA and ATAC row identities and evaluate only at donor-compatible resolution; never manufacture cell or nucleus pairs
missingness_and_pairing_contract.gse281160: same_cell guide and RNA observations, but experimental replicates rather than cells or guides are inferential units
missingness_and_pairing_contract.gse281364: same_sample_different_aliquot reporter DNA and RNA counts; experimental replicates are inferential units
missingness_and_pairing_contract.gse289173: same_study_unpaired RNA and QTL summaries; no sealed ATAC is available and outcomes remain evaluator-only
missingness_and_pairing_contract.gse296875: same_nucleus; exact barcode-to-donor and ordered RNA-ATAC joins must pass before training; donors remain inferential units
missingness_and_pairing_contract.model_mask_requirement: Every missing or unavailable modality is represented by an explicit state and mask.

noninheritance_contract.base_component_crosswalk: A selected sequence backbone and cell encoder each require their own frozen corpus crosswalk. Their findings remain component-level and are not sufficient for the locally fitted composite.
noninheritance_contract.rule: The official Borzoi ensemble predates some project sources, but context_borzoi does not exist and may be trained on later project data. It therefore remains unknown for every source until the exact selected components and local training receipt are frozen.

fnih_86_liver.restriction: No activation unless open download, rights, donor joins, modalities, reference, and outcomes pass before selection lock.

gse244832.restriction: No fitting, tuning, feature selection, calibration, or cell-level pairing on the held development partition.

gse296875.restriction: Within-fold held donors and their ATAC remain excluded from every fitted transform and model input.

current_coloc_gwas.restriction: Corrected graph snapshot and task labels must be frozen before use.

gse244832.restriction: Use assay-native donor-compatible supervision only; never infer false paired cells.

gse281160.restriction: The 20 MPRA-selected targets are not an unbiased validation set.

gse281364.restriction: Only held-locus predictions are eligible; MPRA cannot supervise signed cell-type eQTL or ieQTL effects.

gse289173.restriction: Features are anonymized for inference, ATAC and outcomes are unavailable, prediction hashes are committed before one evaluator-only label join.

gse296875.restriction: Cross donors with held chromosome or LD blocks and a full selected-backbone boundary buffer.

rules.component_exposure: The composite exposure is at least as restrictive as any selected pretrained component plus every local fit, adapter, head, mapper, calibration, and downstream demonstration.
rules.final_development_fit: A source used in the final local fit is continual_seen for the resulting artifact even if donor/genomic cross-fitting supplied development estimates.
rules.sealed: GSE289173 may become target_label_unexposed only after all components, local data, preprocessing, code, runtime, trained state, outputs, and thresholds are locked without its labels or QTL outcomes. Current state is unknown.
rules.sequence_overlap: Reference-sequence familiarity is handled by merged chromosome/LD blocks and a boundary buffer equal to the selected model's largest receptive field; it does not substitute for target-exposure auditing.
